title: Seven Nation Army
headline: A label exec heard this riff and said Jack White could do better. Then stadiums took it.
caption:
Jack White came up with the riff for "Seven Nation Army" at the Corner Hotel in Melbourne, on the Australian leg of a White Stripes tour. One label exec didn't think much of it. Jack used it anyway.

One detail we love: Melbourne Victory, an A-League Men team, plays the song at home games after a goal. Their stadium, AAMI Park, sits about 700 meters from the Corner Hotel, where the riff was born.

And the Bond dream came true after all. Five years later, Jack wrote and performed "Another Way to Die" with Alicia Keys for Quantum of Solace.

Where's the most memorable place you've heard a crowd sing this riff?

🎧 The song: "Seven Nation Army" by The White Stripes (@thewhitestripes)
